description:
Convert an array of JSON objects to CSV. Columns are inferred from the union of keys.

Returns: CSV string with a header row derived from the first object's keys.
Example input: {"json":"[{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"age\":36},{\"name\":\"Grace\",\"age\":85}]","delimiter":","}
On error, includes hint: `json` must be a JSON-encoded array of objects (parameter name is `json`, not `text`).

json.description: JSON array of objects, as a string.

name: json_to_csv
title: JSON to CSV
